Pilot raises a $4.5M seed round to build the internet for agents

Pilot has raised a $4.5M seed round to build the internet for agents; the launch announcement reported roughly 250,000 cumulative registered addresses.

Read announcement →Editorial scope

What belongs in the newsroom.

The newsroom is the source for official Pilot Protocol announcements: company milestones, product releases, financing, partnerships, and changes that materially affect users or publishers. Each item identifies its publication date and links to the technical or company material needed to evaluate the announcement.

Architecture tutorials, implementation notes, and opinionated engineering analysis live in the technical journal. Product behavior is documented in the documentation, while current priorities belong on the roadmap. Keeping those collections distinct makes updates easier to verify and avoids presenting editorial guidance as a company announcement.

For a source, clarification, or correction, contact press@pilotprotocol.network or use the correction form. Our authorship, review, and update practices are described in our publishing standards.
